revisions.body_markdown:
# Objective
Create `docs/RUNTIME_RECOVERY_VERIFIED.md` as a concise operator guide for Verified runtime recovery and correction in the bounded local Hermes adapter.
# Authority
Read AGENTS.md, docs/LOCAL_RUNTIME.md, foundry_runtime/core.py, runtime.py, worker.py and remote.py.
The operator has prepared the initial runtime prerequisites. Review and preserve their safety properties.
# Scope and non-goals
Worker changes only `docs/RUNTIME_RECOVERY_VERIFIED.md`. Do not change code, tests, profiles, secrets or AI.Contract. Do not deploy.
The delivered candidate intentionally includes the operator-authored runtime prerequisites, tests, preflight and LOCAL_RUNTIME.md since the remote baseline. These are authorized prerequisite changes; QA must review those files as well as this guide. Worker writes only the guide.
# Dependencies and conflicts
No prerequisites. Independent documentation file; no shared mutable code or target integration ownership.
# Acceptance criteria
The guide accurately explains these concepts: AI.Contract, isolated, retry, history, paging, breaker. Include one practical recovery or verification example grounded in source. Avoid unverified acceptance claims.
Worker runs the supplied checks and submits an actual commit. Independent QA inspects the exact candidate and relevant runtime safety controls, independently runs checks and records evidence. QA acceptance is not Done.
# Verification and delivery
Use the check capability. Coordinator integrates serially, verifies expected-head non-force main delivery and postchecks, then records native Done and historical issue. No deployment.

# Authorized staged acceptance fixture
This contract deliberately exercises independent correction, not immediate final approval.
The first Worker MUST submit an initial guide WITHOUT a verification marker. This is an
explicit authorized draft review, an exception to requiring all final evidence before a first submission.
After service-container replacement the Coordinator records a fresh verification_marker in native history.
QA MUST read that current record, independently run the supplied marker check, and request changes
when it is absent. Include the exact expected marker in the actionable QA findings.
The same Worker/attempt MUST then add the exact marker from latest QA feedback, explain it as
disposable acceptance evidence, check again and submit a changed immutable candidate.
Fresh independent QA must check the corrected candidate. Only the corrected accepted candidate may be delivered.
Read history through all necessary pages; heartbeat/record noise is not the latest QA finding.

Worker runs the supplied checks and submits an actual commit. Independent QA inspects the exact candidate and relevant runtime safety controls, independently runs checks and records evidence. QA acceptance is not Done.
# Verification and delivery
Use the check capability. Coordinator integrates serially, verifies expected-head non-force main delivery and postchecks, then records native Done and historical issue. No deployment.

# Authorized staged acceptance fixture
This contract deliberately exercises independent correction, not immediate final approval.
The first Worker MUST submit an initial guide WITHOUT a verification marker. This is an
explicit authorized draft review, an exception to requiring all final evidence before a first submission.
After service-container replacement the Coordinator records a fresh verification_marker in native history.
QA MUST read that current record, independently run the supplied marker check, and request changes
when it is absent. Include the exact expected marker in the actionable QA findings.
The same Worker/attempt MUST then add the exact marker from latest QA feedback, explain it as
disposable acceptance evidence, check again and submit a changed immutable candidate.
Fresh independent QA must check the corrected candidate. Only the corrected accepted candidate may be delivered.
Read history through all necessary pages; heartbeat/record noise is not the latest QA finding.
